Hi, I like dogs. I like people, I like teaching people about dogs. 

We do this 100% to help you the dog owners at home, do us a favor and subscribe to the channel to show support for what we are doing! Do you want Thomas to cover anything bothering you at home? Simply leave a comment in the newest video with what you want to see! 

Follow us on Instagram- @tomdavis or @nobadogs
Facebook- America's Canine Educator 
Podcast - Search, NO BAD DOGS on your podcast platform!
